subject: Potential independent coffee-shop recognition framework for Culture Passport
summary: Coffee shop interviews may use separate venue, roaster, product, design and barista-award evidence; proposal only, pending user approval. No new confirmed personal café visits implied.

coreRules.visitEvidence: Direct user confirmation of a café visit is required before adding to confirmed Passport experiences. The actual location must be identified. Never infer dates, drinks, or companions.
coreRules.provenance: Store award name, year, category, issuer, result (winner, honoree, finalist, selected/ranked), official URL, and recipient. Preserve historical awards and closed venues.
coreRules.locationAccuracy: An award to one café location does not automatically apply to every branch. A roaster or product award attaches to the company or coffee, never to unrelated cafés merely serving the product.
coreRules.publication: No automatic public publication, and no promotion of wishlisted/not-visited venues into confirmed visits.
coreRules.review: The following standards are suggestions; do not add to canonical eligibility policy or award stats without user approval.

examples.caveat: Commercial ranking uses 70% expert plus 30% public voting; label as ranked selection, not a judged medal.
Industry/community-nominated recognition; distinguish winner from honoree and finalist.
Design distinction is about space and presentation, not necessarily coffee flavor or cup quality.

examples.outcome: Winning coffee roaster operated the actual visited café
examples.caveat: Award is to company, not individual coffee-shop branches.

examples.outcome: Winning roasted coffee made by a roaster operating the visited café
examples.caveat: Product award only. Product being served by a shop is insufficient unless the shop is actually operated by recipient.

examples.outcome: Barista or competitor associated with a venue at time of competition
examples.caveat: Awards belong to individuals. Require verified employment/ownership and separate personal café visit before considering a contextual linkage.

exclusions: Google star ratings, Yelp stars or social-media popularity alone do not qualify as formal awards.
An unverified 'best coffee shop' blog list does not automatically qualify.
Do not call award finalist a winner, or coffee product recognition a physical café award.
archivePolicy: Retain confirmed café visits without qualifying awards privately, under recognition watch. Maintain separate confirmed, maybe, not visited and wishlist states.
transition: Proposal: add a Coffee & Cafés chapter or category under Culture Passport only after user confirms criteria. The coffee proposal must not merge with food-restaurant Michelin/JBF or CAMRA pub category semantics.
